## Privacy Information for Lifestyle-Scoring-App
Last updated: 16.11.2023
I highly value the protection of your data and your privacy. This privacy information explains how I handle your personal data when you use the Lifestyle-Scoring-App.
**1. Data Controller**
The data controller is:
Jens Münker E-Mail: frosch2040@gmail.com
**2. Data Collection**
I only collect and process data that is required for the functionality of the Lifestyle-Scoring-App. This currently includes:
- Camera access: The app requires access to the camera to scan the cards of the card game.
**3. Use of Data**
The collected data is used exclusively for the stated purpose, namely to provide the functions of the Lifestyle-Scoring-App. No analysis or sharing with third parties takes place.
**4. Data Storage**
Captured data is stored locally on your device and not on servers. After card recognition, the data is deleted.
**5. Data Sharing**
Since I do not collect personal data, there is no sharing of such data with third parties.
**6. User Rights**
You have the right to information about stored data concerning your person. You also have the right to correction, deletion, or blocking of incorrect data. Please contact me using the contact details from section 1.
**7. Changes to this Privacy Information**
I reserve the right to update this privacy information if needed. The latest version is available on the [GitHub page for English](https://github.com/jens-muenker/Lifestyle-Scoring-App/blob/main/privacy_policy/privacy_policy_en.md).
**8. Contact**
For questions or concerns regarding this privacy information, please contact frosch2040@gmail.com.
